{{Short description|Vector and tensor}}
{{Use British (Oxford) English|date=January 2012}}

'''ISO 31-11:1992''' was the part of [[international standard]] [[ISO 31]] that defines ''mathematical signs and symbols for use in physical sciences and technology''. It was superseded in 2009 by ISO 80000-2:2009 and subsequently revised in 2019 as [[ISO/IEC 80000#Part_2:_Mathematics|ISO-80000-2:2019]].<ref>{{cite web|title=ISO 80000-2:2019|date= 19 May 2020 |url= https://www.iso.org/standard/64973.html |publisher=[[International Organization for Standardization]]|access-date=4 Oct 2021}}</ref>

It included definitions for symbols for [[mathematical logic]], [[set theory]], [[arithmetic]] and [[complex number]]s, [[function (mathematics)|functions]] and [[special function]]s and values, [[matrix (mathematics)|matrices]], [[vector (mathematics)|vectors]], and [[tensor]]s, [[coordinate system]]s, and miscellaneous [[mathematical relation]]s.<ref name = "ISO 31-11">
